Area.evidence_source: In Canada, men account for four out of every five deaths by suicide (Statistics Canada, 2012), and suicide is the second leading cause of death for men 15 to 24 years old. While suicide has been linked to a variety of factors including substance use, history of trauma and family violence, sexual abuse, and distress related to sexual identity (Afif et al., 2008; MacKenzie et al., 2011), severe depression is the most powerful predictor of suicide behaviors and suicide (Gonzalez, 2008).
